stdin:
set -eu
pid=$(systemctl show xochitl -p MainPID --value)
printf 'ADAPTER_MAP\n'
grep '/home/root/xovi/extensions.d/pi-ink-loopback-experiment.so' /proc/"$pid"/maps
if grep -q '/home/root/.*/webserver-remote.so' /proc/"$pid"/maps; then printf 'CONFLICT_STILL_MAPPED\n'; exit 1; fi
printf 'ALLOWLISTED_ACTIVATION_MARKER\n'
journalctl -u xochitl --since '-5 minutes' --no-pager --output=cat --grep '^PI_INK_LOOPBACK_0014 loaded;'
printf 'LOCAL_ENDPOINT\n'
test -x /home/root/.vellum/bin/curl
/home/root/.vellum/bin/curl --noproxy '*' --max-time 8 --silent --show-error --output /dev/null --write-out 'ROOT_HTTP_STATUS=%{http_code}\n' http://127.0.0.1:81/
printf 'XOCHITL_SOCKET_DESCRIPTORS\n'
for descriptor in /proc/"$pid"/fd/*; do target=$(readlink "$descriptor") || continue; case "$target" in socket:*) printf '%s %s\n' "$descriptor" "$target";; esac; done
